title: Extract duplicated TTL cache logic into a shared helper
instruction: Both `user_service.py` and `product_service.py` contain an identical `_get_cached` helper that implements a simple TTL cache using a dict and timestamps. Extract this logic into a new file `cache.py` that exposes a `TtlCache` class with `get(key)` and `set(key, value)` methods and a `ttl_seconds` constructor argument. Update both service files to import and use `TtlCache` instead of their local helpers. All existing tests must continue to pass.
